saints.name: St. Stephen of Hungary
saints.title: King
saints.shortBlurb: The first Christian king of Hungary, who converted his people and founded its Church…
biography: Born about 975 and baptized in his youth, Stephen succeeded his father as ruler of the Magyars and was crowned first king of Hungary around the year 1000 with a crown sent, by tradition, from Pope Sylvester II. He labored to make his still largely pagan people Christian, putting down revolts against the new faith.

Stephen organized the Hungarian Church into dioceses, built churches and monasteries, and gave his kingdom just laws rooted in the Gospel. The early death of his son St. Emeric was a great sorrow to him; he died in 1038 and was canonized in 1083, honored ever after as the father of Christian Hungary.
saints.knownFor: Establishing Christianity and the Church in Hungary.

sources.text: Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), “St. Stephen I of Hungary”
